# OpenGameArt background-music source freeze

Frozen for Beastbound Odyssey Phase 335 on 2026-07-25 (Asia/Shanghai).
The source files are stored unchanged; all transforms occur in the
deterministic bundle builder and are recorded in `source/provenance.json`.

| cue | source title | author | source page | selected license | frozen source SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `music.town` | Town Theme RPG | ComposerBeck | <https://opengameart.org/content/town-theme-rpg-0> | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | `cdd0b06d587475fc69634e27f3c351c3c874585f137063a3b0500ac0abd82918` |
| `music.wilderness` | The Field Of Dreams | pauliuw | <https://opengameart.org/content/the-field-of-dreams> | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | `103a7032a49be7e8399c5cb771f7759eac9ac1a0d2bf227f41fff42ad8d78194` |
| `music.cave` | Cave Theme | Brandon Morris (`Brandon75689`, submitted by `HaelDB`) | <https://opengameart.org/content/cave-theme> | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | `1ddf7a0845c808136edfda7ea829e48fa2b7c57793e008d706dadbb5917dff9c` |
| `music.battle_normal` | A Regular Battle | Telaron | <https://opengameart.org/content/a-regular-battle> | [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | `fd7b2d4658628cff2aaf1a6596a0126ad1557fb8fc3bcab440843889dfbb135c` |
